_comment: 英语种子题库: 北师大版七年级上册. 单元名以课本为准, 题目按语法知识点标签组织. type: choice/fill 可硬判, answer 需AI判.
subject: 英语

questions.stem: —What's your name?  —____ name is Lucy.
questions.explain: 后面有名词 name，要用形容词性物主代词 My。Mine 是名词性物主代词，后面不能再跟名词。

questions.stem: This is my brother. ____ is a student.
questions.explain: brother 是男性，作主语用主格 He。His 是物主代词，不能作主语。

questions.stem: My mother ____ a teacher.
questions.explain: 主语 my mother 是第三人称单数，用 is。口诀：I 用 am，you 用 are，is 连着他她它。

questions.stem: They ____ from Beijing.
questions.explain: They 是复数，用 are。

questions.stem: —____ is your father?  —He is 40.
questions.explain: 答语是年龄 40，所以问"多大年纪"用 How old。

questions.stem: I ____ got a sister.
questions.explain: have got 表示"有"，主语 I 用 have。第三人称单数是 has got。

questions.stem: She ____ got long hair.
questions.explain: 第三人称单数 she 用 has got。

questions.stem: My uncle is tall and he ____ glasses.
questions.explain: 主语 he 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词加 -s：wears。

questions.stem: My father's brother is my ____.
questions.explain: 爸爸的兄弟是叔叔/伯伯，英文统称 uncle。

questions.stem: 把句子改成一般疑问句：She is from Shanghai.  → ____ ____ from Shanghai?
questions.explain: 含 be 动词的句子变一般疑问句，把 be 提到句首：Is she from Shanghai?

questions.stem: 把句子改成否定句：He is a student.  → He ____ a student.
questions.explain: be 动词变否定直接加 not：is not，缩写为 isn't。

questions.stem: —What's your favourite ____?  —Maths.
questions.explain: maths 是一门科目，所以问 subject（科目）。

questions.stem: He ____ up at six every day.
questions.explain: every day 说明是习惯性动作，用一般现在时；主语 he 三单，动词加 -s：gets。

questions.stem: My sister ____ like maths.
questions.explain: 主语三单，否定用 doesn't，且后面动词要还原成原形 like（doesn't 已经体现了三单）。

questions.stem: —Do you like music?  —Yes, I ____.
questions.explain: Do 提问就用 do 回答，保持助动词一致。

questions.stem: I ____ go to school on foot, about five days a week.
questions.explain: 一周五天步行上学，频率很高，用 usually（通常）。never 从不，seldom 很少，都不符合。

questions.stem: We have English ____ Monday.
questions.explain: 具体某一天（星期几）前用 on。

questions.stem: I go to bed ____ nine o'clock.
questions.explain: 具体时刻前用 at。口诀：at 用于时刻，on 用于某天，in 用于年月季节。

questions.stem: 用所给词的适当形式填空：Tom ____ (have) lunch at school.
questions.explain: 主语 Tom 是三单，have 的三单形式是 has（不规则变化，不是 haves）。

questions.stem: —____ do you go to school?  —By bike.
questions.explain: 答语是交通方式，问"怎样去"用 How。

questions.stem: 根据中文写单词：图书馆 ____
questions.explain: library /ˈlaɪbrəri/，注意发音和拼写，中间是 br 不是 vr。

questions.stem: 根据中文写单词：星期三 ____
questions.explain: Wednesday，注意大写首字母，拼写里有不发音的 d。

questions.stem: 根据中文写单词：字典 ____
questions.explain: dictionary，注意是 -ary 结尾。

questions.stem: There ____ some books on the desk.
questions.explain: there be 句型中 be 由后面的名词决定，books 是复数，用 are。注意 there be 和 have 不能混用。

questions.stem: —____ there a library in your school?  —Yes, there is.
questions.explain: 一般疑问句把 be 提前；a library 是单数，用 Is。

questions.stem: There ____ a pen and two books on the desk.
questions.explain: there be 遵循"就近原则"，离 be 最近的 a pen 是单数，所以用 is。

questions.stem: The book is ____ the desk.（书在桌子上面）
questions.explain: 在物体表面用 on。

questions.stem: How ____ milk do you want?
questions.explain: milk 是不可数名词，用 how much 提问数量；how many 后面跟可数名词复数。

questions.stem: 根据中文写单词：厨房 ____
questions.explain: kitchen /ˈkɪtʃɪn/，注意 ch 的拼写。

questions.stem: ____ you swim?
questions.explain: 问"会不会游泳"表示能力，用情态动词 Can，后面动词用原形 swim。

questions.stem: I can play ____ piano.
questions.explain: 乐器前要加定冠词 the，play the piano。球类前则不加，如 play football。

questions.stem: Let's ____ football after school.
questions.explain: Let's 后面接动词原形，Let's do sth.

questions.stem: —Is this your bag?  —No, it isn't ____.
questions.explain: 横线后没有名词，要用名词性物主代词 mine（= my bag）。

questions.stem: —What does your mother do?  —She is ____ nurse.
questions.explain: 表示职业，单数可数名词前加 a；nurse 以辅音音素开头，用 a 不用 an。

questions.stem: Look! The children ____ basketball on the playground.
questions.explain: Look! 提示动作正在发生，用现在进行时 be + doing；children 是复数，用 are playing。

questions.stem: Write a short passage (about 50 words) about your family: how many people are there, what they look like and what they like doing.
questions.answer: 参考要点: 使用 There are ... people in my family. 介绍成员 (My father is tall and he likes reading.) 注意三单动词加 -s，注意人称代词与物主代词的区分。语法准确、要点齐全即可得分。
questions.explain: 这题由 AI 按"要点齐全 + 语法准确"评分，属参考分。写作时注意：先列要点再下笔，每句只表达一个意思，写完检查三单和名词单复数。
